versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐπορεύετο, καὶ προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπιδεῖξαι αὐτῷ τὰς οἰκοδομὰς τοῦ ἱεροῦ.

controles.web: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
controles.kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
controles.livre: Jesus saiu do templo, e se foi. Então seus discípulos se aproximaram dele para lhe mostrarem os edifícios do complexo do templo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐ βλέπετε ταῦτα πάντα; ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ ἀφεθῇ ὧδε λίθος ἐπὶ λίθον ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται.

controles.web: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus lhes disse: Não vedes tudo isto? Em verdade vos digo, que não será deixada aqui pedra sobre pedra, que não seja derrubada.

versos.grego: Καθημένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους τῶν Ἐλαιῶν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ κατ’ ἰδίαν λέγοντες Εἰπὲ ἡμῖν, πότε ταῦτα ἔσται, καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον τῆς σῆς παρουσίας καὶ συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος;

controles.web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”
controles.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
controles.livre: E, depois de se assentar no monte das Oliveiras, os discípulos se aproximaram dele reservadamente, perguntando: Dize-nos, quando serão estas coisas, e que sinal haverá da tua vinda, e do fim da era?

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς πλανήσῃ.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Permanecei atentos, para que ninguém vos engane.

versos.grego: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ Χριστός, καὶ πολλοὺς πλανήσουσιν.

controles.web: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
controles.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
controles.livre: Porque muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: “Eu sou o Cristo”, e enganarão a muitos.

versos.grego: μελλήσετε δὲ ἀκούειν πολέμους καὶ ἀκοὰς πολέμων· ὁρᾶτε, μὴ θροεῖσθε· δεῖ γὰρ γενέσθαι, ἀλλ’ οὔπω ἐστὶν τὸ τέλος.

controles.web: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
controles.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
controles.livre: E ouvireis de guerras, e de rumores de guerras. Olhai que não vos espanteis; porque é necessário, que isto aconteça, mas ainda não é o fim.

versos.grego: ἐγερθήσεται γὰρ ἔθνος ἐπὶ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν, καὶ ἔσονται λιμοὶ καὶ σεισμοὶ κατὰ τόπους·

controles.web: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
controles.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
controles.livre: Pois se levantará nação contra nação, e reino contra reino; e haverá fomes, e terremotos em diversos lugares.

versos.grego: πάντα δὲ ταῦτα ἀρχὴ ὠδίνων.

controles.web: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
controles.kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
controles.livre: Mas todas estas coisas são o começo das dores.

versos.grego: τότε παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς θλῖψιν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου.

controles.web: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
controles.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.
controles.livre: Então vos entregarão para serdes afligidos, e vos matarão; e sereis odiados por todas as nações, por causa de meu nome.

versos.grego: καὶ τότε σκανδαλισθήσονται πολλοὶ καὶ ἀλλήλους παραδώσουσιν καὶ μισήσουσιν ἀλλήλους·

controles.web: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
controles.kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
controles.livre: E muitos se tornarão infiéis; e trairão uns aos outros, e uns aos outros se odiarão.

versos.grego: καὶ πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐγερθήσονται καὶ πλανήσουσιν πολλούς·

controles.web: Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.
controles.kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
controles.livre: E muitos falsos profetas se levantarão, e enganarão a muitos.

versos.grego: καὶ διὰ τὸ πληθυνθῆναι τὴν ἀνομίαν ψυγήσεται ἡ ἀγάπη τῶν πολλῶν.

controles.web: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
controles.kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
controles.livre: E, por se multiplicar a injustiça, o amor de muitos se esfriará.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος, οὗτος σωθήσεται.

controles.web: But he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.
controles.kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
controles.livre: Mas o que perseverar até o fim, esse será salvo.

versos.grego: καὶ κηρυχθήσεται τοῦτο τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ εἰς μαρτύριον πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, καὶ τότε ἥξει τὸ τέλος.

controles.web: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
controles.kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
controles.livre: E este Evangelho do Reino será pregado em todo o mundo, como testemunho a todas as nações, e então virá o fim.

versos.grego: Ὅταν οὖν ἴδητε τὸ βδέλυγμα τῆς ἐρημώσεως τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Δανιὴλ τοῦ προφήτου ἑστὸς ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ, ὁ ἀναγινώσκων νοείτω,

controles.web: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),
controles.kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
controles.livre: Portanto, quando virdes que a abominação da desolação, dita pelo profeta Daniel, está no lugar santo, (quem lê, entenda),

versos.grego: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη,

controles.web: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
controles.kjv: Then let them which be in Judea flee into the mountains:
controles.livre: então os que estiveram na Judeia fujam para os montes;

versos.grego: ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος μὴ καταβάτω ἆραι τὰ ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out things that are in his house.
controles.kjv: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
controles.livre: o que estiver no sobre o telhado não desça para tirar as coisas de sua casa;

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω ὀπίσω ἆραι τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
controles.kjv: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
controles.livre: e o que estiver no campo não volte atrás para tomar a sua capa.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις.

controles.web: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!
controles.kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
controles.livre: Mas ai das grávidas e das que amamentarem naqueles dias!

versos.grego: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ γένηται ἡ φυγὴ ὑμῶν χειμῶνος μηδὲ σαββάτῳ·

controles.web: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter, nor on a Sabbath,
controles.kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
controles.livre: Orai, porém, para que a vossa fuga não aconteça no inverno, nem no sábado.

versos.grego: ἔσται γὰρ τότε θλῖψις μεγάλη, οἵα οὐ γέγονεν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κόσμου ἕως τοῦ νῦν οὐδ’ οὐ μὴ γένηται.

controles.web: for then there will be great oppression, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.
controles.kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
controles.livre: Pois haverá então grande aflição, como nunca houve desde o princípio do mundo até agora, nem jamais haverá.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκολοβώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι, οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ· διὰ δὲ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς κολοβωθήσονται αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι.

controles.web: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.
controles.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
controles.livre: E se aqueles dias não fossem encurtados, ninguém  se salvaria;  mas por causa dos escolhidos, aqueles dias serão encurtados.

versos.grego: τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ Ἰδοὺ ὧδε ὁ Χριστός, ἤ Ὧδε, μὴ πιστεύσητε·

controles.web: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.
controles.kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
controles.livre: Então, se alguém vos disser: “Olha o Cristo aqui”, ou “ Olha ele ali”, não creiais,

versos.grego: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται, καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα μεγάλα καὶ τέρατα ὥστε πλανῆσαι, εἰ δυνατὸν, καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς.

controles.web: For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
controles.kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
controles.livre: pois se levantarão falsos cristos e falsos profetas; e farão tão grandes sinais e prodígios que, se fosse possível, enganariam até os escolhidos.

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ προείρηκα ὑμῖν.

controles.web: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.
controles.kjv: Behold, I have told you before.
controles.livre: Eis que eu tenho vos dito com antecedência.

versos.grego: ἐὰν οὖν εἴπωσιν ὑμῖν Ἰδοὺ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐστίν, μὴ ἐξέλθητε· Ἰδοὺ ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις, μὴ πιστεύσητε·

controles.web: If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.
controles.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
controles.livre: Portanto, se vos disserem: “Eis que ele está no deserto”, não saiais; “Eis que ele está em um recinto”, não creiais.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ ἀστραπὴ ἐξέρχεται ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ φαίνεται ἕως δυσμῶν, οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου·

controles.web: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
controles.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
controles.livre: Porque, assim como o relâmpago, que sai do oriente, e aparece até o ocidente, assim também será a vinda do Filho do homem.

versos.grego: ὅπου ἐὰν ᾖ τὸ πτῶμα, ἐκεῖ συναχθήσονται οἱ ἀετοί.

controles.web: For wherever the carcass is, there is where the vultures gather together.
controles.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
controles.livre: Onde estiver o cadáver, ali se ajuntarão os abutres.

versos.grego: Εὐθέως δὲ μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐκείνων ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται, καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς, καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες πεσοῦνται ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται.

controles.web: But immediately after the oppression of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
controles.kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
controles.livre: E logo depois da aflição  daqueles dias, o sol se escurecerá, a lua não dará o seu brilho, as estrelas cairão do céu, e as forças dos céus se estremecerão.

versos.grego: καὶ τότε φανήσεται τὸ σημεῖον τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν οὐρανῷ, καὶ τότε κόψονται πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐπὶ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς·

controles.web: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
controles.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
controles.livre: Então aparecerá no céu o sinal do Filho do homem. Naquela hora todas as tribos da terra lamentarão, e verão ao Filho do homem, que vem sobre as nuvens do céu, com poder e grande glória.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ μετὰ σάλπιγγος μεγάλης, καὶ ἐπισυνάξουσιν τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ’ ἄκρων οὐρανῶν ἕως ἄκρων αὐτῶν.

controles.web: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
controles.kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
controles.livre: E enviará os seus anjos com grande trombeta, e ajuntarão os seus escolhidos desde os quatro ventos, de uma extremidade à outra dos céus.

versos.grego: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν· ὅταν ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς γένηται ἁπαλὸς καὶ τὰ φύλλα ἐκφύῃ, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος·

controles.web: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.
controles.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
controles.livre: Aprendei a parábola da figueira: “Quando os seus ramos já ficam verdes, e as folhas brotam, sabeis que o verão está perto”.

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ἴδητε πάντα ταῦτα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις.

controles.web: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
controles.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
controles.livre: Assim também vós, quando virdes todas estas coisas, sabei que já está perto, às portas.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως ἂν πάντα ταῦτα γένηται.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, this generationwill not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo que esta geração não passará, até que todas estas coisas aconteçam.

versos.grego: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσεται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρέλθωσιν.

controles.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
controles.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
controles.livre: O céu e a terra passarão, mas minhas palavras de maneira nenhuma passarão.

versos.grego: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης καὶ ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν, οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι τῶν οὐρανῶν οὐδὲ ὁ Υἱός, εἰ μὴ ὁ Πατὴρ μόνος.

controles.web: But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven,but my Father only.
controles.kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
controles.livre: Porém daquele dia e hora, ninguém sabe, nem os anjos do céu, nem o Filho,  a não ser meu Pai somente.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ Νῶε, οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: “As the days of Noah were, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
controles.kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
controles.livre: Assim como foram os dias de Noé, assim também será a vinda do Filho do homem.

versos.grego: ὡς γὰρ ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ταῖς πρὸ τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ τρώγοντες καὶ πίνοντες, γαμοῦντες καὶ γαμίζοντες, ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας εἰσῆλθεν Νῶε εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν,

controles.web: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
controles.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
controles.livre: Pois, assim como naqueles dias antes do dilúvio comiam, bebiam, casavam, e davam-se em casamento, até o dia em que Noé entrou na arca;

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ἕως ἦλθεν ὁ κατακλυσμὸς καὶ ἦρεν ἅπαντας, οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: and they didn’t know until the flood came, and took them all away, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
controles.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
controles.livre: e não sabiam, até que veio o dilúvio, e levou todos, assim também será a vinda do Filho do homem.

versos.grego: τότε ἔσονται δύο ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ, εἷς παραλαμβάνεται καὶ εἷς ἀφίεται·

controles.web: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left;
controles.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
controles.livre: Naquela hora dois estarão no campo; um será tomado, e o outro será deixado.

versos.grego: δύο ἀλήθουσαι ἐν τῷ μύλῳ, μία παραλαμβάνεται καὶ μία ἀφίεται.

controles.web: two women grinding at the mill, one will be taken and one will be left.
controles.kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
controles.livre: Duas estarão moendo em um moinho; uma será tomada, e a outra será deixada.

versos.grego: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε ποίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ κύριος ὑμῶν ἔρχεται.

controles.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
controles.kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
controles.livre: Vigiai, pois, porque não sabeis em que dia o vosso Senhor virá.

versos.grego: ἐκεῖνο δὲ γινώσκετε ὅτι εἰ ᾔδει ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης ποίᾳ φυλακῇ ὁ κλέπτης ἔρχεται, ἐγρηγόρησεν ἂν καὶ οὐκ ἂν εἴασεν διορυχθῆναι τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
controles.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
controles.livre: Porém sabei isto: se o dono de casa soubesse a que hora  da noite o ladrão viria, vigiaria, e não deixaria invadir a sua casa.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ὑμεῖς γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι, ὅτι ᾗ οὐ δοκεῖτε ὥρᾳ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεται.

controles.web: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
controles.kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
controles.livre: Portanto também vós estai prontos, porque o Filho do homem virá na hora que não esperais.

versos.grego: Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς δοῦλος καὶ φρόνιμος ὃν κατέστησεν ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκετείας αὐτοῦ τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς τὴν τροφὴν ἐν καιρῷ;

controles.web: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
controles.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
controles.livre: Pois quem é o servo fiel e prudente, ao qual o seu senhor pôs sobre os seus trabalhadores, para lhes dar alimento no tempo devido?

versos.grego: μακάριος ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει οὕτως ποιοῦντα·

controles.web: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.
controles.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
controles.livre: Feliz  será aquele servo a quem, quando o seu senhor vier, achar fazendo assim.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν αὐτοῦ καταστήσει αὐτόν.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo que ele o porá sobre todos os seus bens.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃ ὁ κακὸς δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Χρονίζει μου ὁ κύριος,

controles.web: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
controles.kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
controles.livre: Porém se aquele servo mau disser em seu coração: “Meu senhor está demorando”,

versos.grego: καὶ ἄρξηται τύπτειν τοὺς συνδούλους αὐτοῦ, ἐσθίῃ δὲ καὶ πίνῃ μετὰ τῶν μεθυόντων,

controles.web: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
controles.kjv: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
controles.livre: e começar a espancar os servos companheiros seus, e a comer, e a beber com os beberrões,

versos.grego: ἥξει ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ οὐ προσδοκᾷ καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ᾗ οὐ γινώσκει,

controles.web: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it, and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
controles.kjv: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
controles.livre: o senhor daquele servo chegará num dia que ele não espera, e numa hora que ele não sabe,

versos.grego: καὶ διχοτομήσει αὐτὸν καὶ τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ὑποκριτῶν θήσει· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

controles.web: and will cut him in pieces, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. There is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
controles.kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
controles.livre: e o despedaçará, e porá sua parte com os hipócritas; ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes.
